public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words be
    for each line in text.to_lower().lines(), piece in line.split(" ")
    where piece is not ""
    collect piece
  let groups be for each token in words group by token collect token
  let mutable entries: List of WordCount be []
  for each key, members in groups
    set entries to entries.append(WordCount(word: key, occurrences: members.length()))
  end
  return for each entry in entries sorted by entry.occurrences descending collect entry
end
```

```
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words: List of Text be
    for each line in text.to_lower().lines(), word in line.split(" ")
    where not word.is_empty()
    collect word
  let entries: List of WordCount be
    for each word in words.distinct()
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: for each other in words where other is word count)
  return for each entry in entries sorted by entry.occurrences descending collect entry
end
